description: Original, reusable design observations for four web page modes; no source artwork, identifiers or business records.

profiles.goal: Plan learning tasks and scan actionable completion status

insights.observed_trait: Comfortably sized labels and visually balanced symbols
insights.tradeoff: Large labels may need responsive reflow
insights.transfer_rule: Use shared nav typography and optically aligned icons
insights.avoid_copying: Do not copy a particular organization's menu labels or glyph layout

insights.observed_trait: Soft background coupled with a clear foreground change
insights.visual_effect: Selection stands out without noisy decoration
insights.tradeoff: Selected text still needs accessible contrast
insights.transfer_rule: Design one role-based active state at project tokens
insights.avoid_copying: Do not copy reference pixel colors or sidebar geometry

insights.observed_trait: Legible rows, aligned columns and minimal badge decoration
insights.tradeoff: On mobile use local scroll or a distinct list layout
insights.transfer_rule: Prefer table when fields are genuinely comparable; keep key text readable
insights.avoid_copying: Do not reproduce any specific record categories, fields or values

profiles.goal: Help visitors evaluate a product and choose an action

insights.observed_trait: Neutral surroundings and a limited accent
insights.task_benefit: Product and primary CTA are easy to locate
insights.tradeoff: Brand identity may require richer colors
insights.transfer_rule: Map surface/primary/semantic colors by role rather than inheriting a palette
insights.avoid_copying: Do not reuse source branding or exact palette

insights.observed_trait: Strong product name and readable supporting facts
insights.tradeoff: Hero display may be intentionally more expressive
insights.transfer_rule: Use task priority and font metrics to assign hierarchy
insights.avoid_copying: Do not clone a specific management-screen heading structure

profiles.goal: Read long lessons and understand adjacent examples

insights.observed_trait: Main text is comfortably readable and metadata quieter
insights.tradeoff: Long prose needs different line length and spacing than tables
insights.transfer_rule: Calibrate body line measure, headings and supporting text as separate roles
insights.avoid_copying: Do not port dense table spacing to articles

insights.observed_trait: Current location uses a restrained highlight
insights.visual_effect: Wayfinding is present but not dominant
insights.task_benefit: Readers can resume the right section
insights.tradeoff: Visible focus and keyboard access remain necessary
insights.transfer_rule: Use active chapter style without replicating a source sidebar
insights.avoid_copying: Do not reproduce any source section taxonomy

insights.observed_trait: Supporting controls avoid competing with the main content
insights.transfer_rule: Reduce surrounding chrome but retain accessible navigation
insights.avoid_copying: Do not convert a creative stage into a business grid

insights.observed_trait: Simple, readable shapes stay consistent at real size
insights.transfer_rule: Curate a coherent icon family and verify semantic fit
insights.avoid_copying: Do not extract logos or icons from a reference image

demo.scenario: Learning workflow planning with entirely fictional labels and records
transfer_focus: muted surfaces with clear primary action
intentionally_different: new local filtering and details interaction
demo.visual_style: Clean Enterprise is an optional art-direction candidate, not a mandatory template
